fiddle.if:
github.event.sender.type != 'Bot' && (
  (
    github.event_name == 'issue_comment'
    && github.event.issue.pull_request
    && contains(github.event.comment.body, '@fiddle-ai')
    && contains(fromJSON('["OWNER", "MEMBER", "COLLABORATOR"]'), github.event.comment.author_association)
  )
  || (
    github.event_name == 'pull_request_review'
    && contains(github.event.review.body, '@fiddle-ai')
    && contains(fromJSON('["OWNER", "MEMBER", "COLLABORATOR"]'), github.event.review.author_association)
  )
)

steps.name: Download fiddle and verify it before it runs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP"
base="https://github.com/${FIDDLE_REPO}/releases/download/${FIDDLE_TAG}"
curl -fsSL -o fiddle-linux-amd64 "${base}/fiddle-linux-amd64"
curl -fsSL -o fiddle-linux-amd64.sha256 "${base}/fiddle-linux-amd64.sha256"

published=$(cut -d ' ' -f 1 fiddle-linux-amd64.sha256)
measured=$(sha256sum fiddle-linux-amd64)
measured=${measured%% *}

if [ "$measured" != "$published" ]; then
  echo "The download does not match the checksum beside it." >&2
  echo "  measured  ${measured}" >&2
  echo "  published ${published}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$measured" != "$FIDDLE_SHA256" ]; then
  echo "${FIDDLE_TAG} publishes a binary this job does not pin." >&2
  echo "  published ${measured}" >&2
  echo "  pinned    ${FIDDLE_SHA256}" >&2
  echo "Read the release. Then update FIDDLE_TAG and FIDDLE_SHA256 together." >&2
  exit 1
fi

chmod +x fiddle-linux-amd64
echo "Verified ${FIDDLE_TAG} ${measured}"

steps.name: Run fiddle on the pull request
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
fiddle="${RUNNER_TEMP}/fiddle-linux-amd64"
"$fiddle" config check --config "$FIDDLE_CONFIG"
"$fiddle" run "pr:${{ github.repository }}#${PULL_REQUEST}" --config "$FIDDLE_CONFIG"
